scope: All application public/private schema metadata; no customer rows or auth credentials.

views.name: enrichment_class_image_audit
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    name,
    provider,
    category,
    is_active,
    image_url,
    logo_url,
        CASE
            WHEN image_url IS NULL THEN 'missing'::text
            WHEN image_url = logo_url THEN 'logo_used_as_hero'::text
            WHEN image_url !~~ 'https://mcyvyqieygpbtcheouzr.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/%'::text THEN 'external_or_unapproved'::text
            ELSE 'approved_supabase_url'::text
        END AS image_status
   FROM enrichment_classes;

views.name: partner_analytics
views.definition:
SELECT ec.id AS partner_id,
    CURRENT_DATE AS stat_date,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE tb.created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND (tb.status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'expired'::text]))) AS bookings_today,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE tb.created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND (tb.status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'expired'::text])))::numeric * 5.0 AS commission_today,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE tb.status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'expired'::text])) AS total_bookings,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE tb.status = 'pending'::text) AS pending_bookings,
    0 AS views_today,
    0 AS leads_today,
    0 AS slots_available,
    NULL::jsonb AS weekly_views
   FROM enrichment_classes ec
     LEFT JOIN trial_bookings tb ON tb.event_id = ec.id
  WHERE ec.is_partner = true AND (ec.provider = (( SELECT profiles.partner_id
           FROM profiles
          WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() AND profiles.role = 'partner'::text)) OR is_admin())
  GROUP BY ec.id;

views.name: partner_fee_summary
views.definition:
SELECT partner_name,
    count(*) AS total_bookings,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN platform_fee_payer = 'user'::text THEN platform_fee_cents
            ELSE 0
        END)::numeric / 100.0 AS user_fees_collected_sgd,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN platform_fee_payer = 'partner'::text THEN platform_fee_cents
            ELSE 0
        END)::numeric / 100.0 AS partner_fees_owed_sgd,
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN partner_invoice_status = 'pending'::text THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS unpaid_invoices,
    max(created_at) AS last_booking
   FROM trial_bookings
  GROUP BY partner_name
  ORDER BY (sum(
        CASE
            WHEN platform_fee_payer = 'partner'::text THEN platform_fee_cents
            ELSE 0
        END)::numeric / 100.0) DESC;

views.name: review_helpful_counts
views.definition:
SELECT review_id,
    count(*)::integer AS helpful_count
   FROM review_helpful
  GROUP BY review_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activity_discovery_claim()
 RETURNS SETOF activity_discovery_sources
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  update public.activity_discovery_sources set lease_until = now()+interval '4 minutes'
  where id = (select id from public.activity_discovery_sources
    where enabled and next_scan_at <= now() and (lease_until is null or lease_until < now())
    order by next_scan_at,id for update skip locked limit 1)
  returning *;
$function$

functions.name: outreach_claim_farm_queries
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.outreach_claim_farm_queries(p_source text, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, query_key text, params jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  UPDATE outreach_farm_queries
  SET status = 'processing', attempts = attempts + 1, last_attempted_at = now()
  WHERE outreach_farm_queries.id IN (
    SELECT ofq.id FROM outreach_farm_queries ofq
    WHERE ofq.source = p_source AND ofq.status = 'pending'
    ORDER BY ofq.created_at
    LIMIT p_limit
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  )
  RETURNING outreach_farm_queries.id, outreach_farm_queries.query_key, outreach_farm_queries.params
$function$

functions.name: outreach_domain
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.outreach_domain(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH host AS (
    SELECT lower(split_part(split_part(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(coalesce(value,''), '^https?://', '', 'i'), '^.*@', ''), '/', 1), ':', 1)) AS h
  ) SELECT CASE
    WHEN h ~ '^[a-z0-9.-]+\.(com|org|net|edu|gov)\.sg$' THEN substring(h from '([^.]+\.[^.]+\.sg)$')
    WHEN h ~ '^[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}$' THEN substring(h from '([^.]+\.[^.]+)$')
    ELSE '' END FROM host
$function$

functions.name: outreach_due_contacts
functions.identity: p_channel text, p_followup_days integer, p_limit integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.outreach_due_contacts(p_channel text, p_followup_days integer, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(contact_id uuid, business_name text, contact_name text, email text, category text, website text, location text, district text, area text, send_kind text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT oc.id,r.canonical_name,NULL::text AS contact_name,oc.email,r.category,r.source_url,
      NULL::text AS location,NULL::text AS district,NULL::text AS area,
      CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.outreach_sends s WHERE s.contact_id=oc.id AND s.status IN ('sent','followup_sent','replied','unsubscribed')) THEN 'initial' ELSE 'followup' END AS kind,
      r.business_domain
    FROM public.outreach_contacts oc
    JOIN public.outreach_business_reviews r ON lower(oc.email)=r.contact_email AND public.outreach_business_domain(oc.website)=r.business_domain
    WHERE NOT oc.do_not_contact AND r.status='approved' AND r.expires_at>now()
      AND r.classifier_version='sg-kids-v1'
      AND NOT public.outreach_is_partner(r.business_domain,r.canonical_name,oc.email)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.outreach_contacts other
        WHERE (public.outreach_business_domain(other.website)=r.business_domain OR public.outreach_business_domain(other.email)=r.business_domain
               OR public.outreach_name_key(other.business_name)=public.outreach_name_key(r.canonical_name))
          AND (other.do_not_contact OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.outreach_sends s WHERE s.contact_id=other.id AND
              (s.status IN ('replied','unsubscribed','followup_sent') OR (other.id<>oc.id AND s.status='sent')))))
      AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.outreach_sends s WHERE s.contact_id=oc.id AND s.status='sent')
           OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.outreach_sends s WHERE s.contact_id=oc.id AND s.channel=p_channel AND s.status='sent'
                     AND s.sent_at < now()-make_interval(days=>greatest(p_followup_days,1))))
      AND p_channel IN ('general','zone','maps')
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.outreach_control WHERE singleton AND NOT paused)
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.outreach_channel_config cfg WHERE cfg.channel=p_channel AND cfg.daily_batch_size>0)
  )
  SELECT id,canonical_name,contact_name,email,category,source_url,location,district,area,kind FROM candidates c
  WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.outreach_send_claims sc WHERE sc.business_domain=c.business_domain AND sc.send_kind=c.kind)
  ORDER BY (kind='followup') DESC,id LIMIT greatest(0,least(coalesce(p_limit,0),500))
$function$

functions.name: outreach_is_partner
functions.identity: p_domain text, p_name text, p_email text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.outreach_is_partner(p_domain text, p_name text, p_email text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.enrichment_classes e
    WHERE e.is_active AND (
      (p_domain <> '' AND p_domain IN (public.outreach_business_domain(e.website_url),public.outreach_business_domain(e.partner_email)))
      OR (public.outreach_name_key(p_name) <> '' AND public.outreach_name_key(p_name)=public.outreach_name_key(e.provider))
      OR (p_email <> '' AND lower(p_email)=lower(e.partner_email)))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_applications a
    WHERE a.status='approved' AND (
      (p_domain <> '' AND p_domain IN (public.outreach_business_domain(a.website),public.outreach_business_domain(a.contact_email),public.outreach_business_domain(a.email)))
      OR (public.outreach_name_key(p_name) <> '' AND public.outreach_name_key(p_name)=public.outreach_name_key(a.business_name))
      OR (p_email <> '' AND lower(p_email) IN (lower(a.email),lower(a.contact_email))))
  )
$function$

  SELECT regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(value,'')), '\m(singapore|sg|pte|ltd|private|limited)\M', '', 'g'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g'), 's$', '')
$function$

functions.name: outreach_review_candidates
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.outreach_review_candidates(p_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(website text, source text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (public.outreach_business_domain(c.website)) c.website,c.source
  FROM public.outreach_contacts c
  LEFT JOIN public.outreach_business_reviews r ON r.business_domain=public.outreach_business_domain(c.website)
  WHERE NOT c.do_not_contact AND c.website ~ '^https?://' AND public.outreach_business_domain(c.website)<>''
    AND (r.business_domain IS NULL OR r.expires_at<=now() OR r.classifier_version<>'sg-kids-v1')
  ORDER BY public.outreach_business_domain(c.website),c.created_at,c.id
  LIMIT greatest(0,least(coalesce(p_limit,0),40))
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_stripe_connect_status(p_account_id text, p_payouts boolean, p_charges boolean, p_details boolean, p_due_count integer, p_disabled_reason text, p_checked_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_account_id, 0));
  if exists (select 1 from public.stripe_connect_status where stripe_account_id=p_account_id and checked_at>p_checked_at) then
    return;
  end if;
  insert into public.stripe_connect_status values
    (p_account_id,p_payouts,p_charges,p_details,p_due_count,p_disabled_reason,p_checked_at)
  on conflict (stripe_account_id) do update set
    payouts_enabled=excluded.payouts_enabled,
    charges_enabled=excluded.charges_enabled,
    details_submitted=excluded.details_submitted,
    requirements_due_count=excluded.requirements_due_count,
    disabled_reason=excluded.disabled_reason,
    checked_at=excluded.checked_at;
  update public.enrichment_classes set payout_enabled=p_payouts where stripe_account_id=p_account_id;
end;
$function$

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if (select auth.role()) in ('anon','authenticated') and
     (new.partner_email is distinct from old.partner_email or
      new.stripe_account_id is distinct from old.stripe_account_id or
      new.payout_enabled is distinct from old.payout_enabled) then
    raise exception 'Stripe settings and partner contacts require backend authorization';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.queue_partner_onboarding_email(p_user_id uuid, p_email text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 insert into public.partner_onboarding_messages(user_id,kind,verified_email)
 select p_user_id,'welcome',lower(trim(p_email))
 where p_email is not null and exists(select 1 from public.enrichment_classes c
  where lower(trim(c.provider))<>'shuyang sports lab'

functions.name: claim_partner_onboarding_messages
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_partner_onboarding_messages(p_limit integer DEFAULT 9)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, user_id uuid, email text, kind text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare message record;
begin
 if p_limit<1 or p_limit>9 then raise exception 'Invalid limit'; end if;
 insert into public.partner_onboarding_messages(user_id,kind,verified_email)
 select m.user_id,'nudge',m.verified_email from public.partner_onboarding_messages m
 where m.kind='welcome' and m.status='sent' and m.sent_at<=now()-interval '3 days'
 and exists(select 1 from public.enrichment_classes c
  where m.verified_email=any(regexp_split_to_array(lower(coalesce(c.partner_email,'')),'[,;\s]+'))
  and lower(trim(c.provider))<>'shuyang sports lab' and not coalesce(c.payout_enabled,false))
 on conflict do nothing;
 for message in select m.id,m.user_id,m.kind,m.verified_email from public.partner_onboarding_messages m
 where m.status='queued' and m.verified_email<>''
 and exists(select 1 from public.enrichment_classes c
  where m.verified_email=any(regexp_split_to_array(lower(coalesce(c.partner_email,'')),'[,;\s]+'))
  and lower(trim(c.provider))<>'shuyang sports lab'
  and (m.kind='welcome' or not coalesce(c.payout_enabled,false)))
 order by m.created_at limit p_limit for update of m skip locked loop
  update public.partner_onboarding_messages m set status='sending' where m.id=message.id;
  id:=message.id;user_id:=message.user_id;email:=message.verified_email;kind:=message.kind;return next;
 end loop;
end $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.queue_paid_booking_analytics()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if current_user not in ('service_role','postgres') then return new; end if;
 if new.status in ('paid','fulfilled') and new.stripe_session_id is not null then
  insert into public.booking_analytics_outbox(event_key,user_id,event,properties)
  values('checkout:'||new.stripe_session_id||':paid',new.profile_id,'checkout_completed',
   jsonb_build_object('listing_id',new.payload->>'event_id','provider',new.payload->>'partner_name',
    'attempt_id',new.booking_id,'stripe_session_id',new.stripe_session_id,'source','server'))
  on conflict do nothing;
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_outreach_deliveries_logged(p_run_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 update public.outreach_delivery_reservations r set logged=true
 where r.run_id=p_run_id and exists(
  select 1 from public.outreach_sends s join public.outreach_contacts c on c.id=s.contact_id
  where lower(trim(c.email))=r.email and s.created_at>=r.created_at
  and s.channel=r.channel
  and s.status in ('sent','followup_sent')
 );
$function$

functions.name: finish_outreach_reservation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_outreach_reservation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.status in ('sent','followup_sent') then
  update public.outreach_delivery_reservations r set logged=true
  from public.outreach_contacts c where c.id=new.contact_id and lower(trim(c.email))=r.email
   and r.channel=new.channel and r.created_at<=new.created_at;
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$
